def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    if 'Price' in df.columns:
        df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[\$,]', '', regex=True).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # drop missing group keys
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Category'])
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df = df[df['Category'].notna() & (df['Category'] != '') & (df['Category'].str.lower() != 'nan')]
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Price'])
    grouped = df.groupby('Category')['Price'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
